title: Sausage and fennel
preamble:
Ingredients:-
8
pork sausages
1
onion - thickly sliced
3
cloves garlic - minced
6
tomatoes - chopped
1/2
fennel bulb
1
desertspoonful tomato puree
3
medium carrots - diced
1
tin flageolet beans
1
red sweet pepper
1/2
pint chicken stock
1
glass of red or white wine

pork sausages
1
onion - thickly sliced
3
cloves garlic - minced
6
tomatoes - chopped
1/2
fennel bulb
1
desertspoonful tomato puree
3
medium carrots - diced
1
tin flageolet beans
1
red sweet pepper
1/2
pint chicken stock
1
glass of red or white wine

Method:-
Pre-heat the oven to Gas Mark 5.
Fry sausages and put aside.
Fry onions until soft, add garlic, carrot, tomato puree and fennel and fry for a couple of minutes.
Add a glass of white or red wine and let it simmer for a couple of minutes.
Add tomatoes and heat through.
Add stock, beans and sweet pepper. Add back the sausages.
Bring to simmer then put in oven for 45 minutes.
